name: Omarchy Knowledge Base
author: Gabriele Baldocci
description: A guided Omarchy tutorial and an ask box in the bar: 40 lessons with one-tap omarchy commands, an offline index that answers most questions instantly, and a Claude fallback for the rest.

barWidget.description: Learn Omarchy chapter by chapter, ask it questions, and run the commands it suggests without leaving the bar.

schema.label: Ask Claude when the offline index has no answer
schema.description: Runs the claude CLI already installed on this machine and sends it only the question you typed. Turn this off to keep the plugin entirely offline; the bundled index still answers on its own.
